name: ConocoPhillips
description: ConocoPhillips is an independent oil and gas producer with no refining or retail arm: it finds and pumps crude oil, bitumen, natural gas liquids and natural gas and sells them into world commodity markets at prevailing prices, plus LNG (liquefied natural gas) projects. Revenue and profit therefore move with oil and gas prices (average crude price $65.62 a barrel in 2025 vs $76.74 in 2024) and production volume. Production jumped 20% to 2,375 thousand barrels of oil equivalent a day in 2025 after the November 2024 acquisition of Marathon Oil, while net income fell to $7,988M from $9,245M because of lower prices.

businessLines.name: Lower 48
businessLines.how: Sells crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas from US onshore unconventional (shale) plays at market prices; profit depends on price per barrel and cost of supply.

revenue.period: FY2025 sales and other operating revenues

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 segment net income (the filing reports segment net income, not operating profit)

businessLines.name: Europe, Middle East and North Africa
businessLines.how: Sells crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas (and LNG) produced from conventional assets in Europe, Africa and the Middle East at market prices; no contracted margin, so profit follows commodity prices and volume.

revenue.period: FY2025 sales and other operating revenues

businessLines.name: Alaska
businessLines.how: Sells crude oil, natural gas liquids and gas produced in Alaska at market prices; production and operating expenses were $2,158M and depreciation $1,399M against $5,638M revenue.

revenue.period: FY2025 sales and other operating revenues

businessLines.name: Canada
businessLines.how: Sells oil sands bitumen, natural gas liquids and gas produced in Canada at market prices (10-K describes oil sands in Canada in its portfolio).

revenue.period: FY2025 sales and other operating revenues

businessLines.name: Asia Pacific
businessLines.how: Sells crude oil, natural gas liquids and LNG produced in Asia Pacific at market prices.

revenue.period: FY2025 sales and other operating revenues

brands.name: Marathon Oil
brands.note: Acquisition completed November 2024; integration finished in the first half of 2025 with more than $1 billion run-rate synergies by year-end 2025.

whatsNext.text: Incremental cost reductions and margin enhancements of more than $1 billion on a run-rate basis (about $0.8 billion from cost reductions after a late-2025 workforce restructuring)
